symptoms: Nausea, vomiting, RUQ pain, jaundice, encephalopathy, coagulopathy

management_steps.details: Activated Charcoal 50g PO if < 1 hour from ingestion. Measure 4-hour post-ingestion serum paracetamol level and plot on nomogram.

1. 1st Dose: 150 mg/kg in 200ml D5W over 1 hour.
2. 2nd Dose: 50 mg/kg in 500ml D5W over 4 hours.
3. 3rd Dose: 100 mg/kg in 1L D5W over 16 hours.
